title: Multi-Agent Runtime: Director → Router → specialists → Merger → approve
acceptance_criteria: Director delegates content and implementation work instead of writing files itself
Router selects the minimum set of specialists; Canon Keeper is always included
Canon, Historical, Game Design, Character, Level, Asset, Technical and QA roles each have a prompt and run in parallel with read-only tools
Merger combines reports into DRAFT entities and PROPOSED code tasks, listing conflicts and open questions
Only the user's approve promotes DRAFT → CANON and PROPOSED → BACKLOG
Every run is logged with route, reports, merge, created and failed items, and visible in the Command Center
Pipeline works offline (rule-based) without an API key
out_of_scope: Streaming progress of a run to the UI
